The deploy timing points to the release, though I did not confirm the message content or the prior version's behaviour. report-cron's pandas ModuleNotFoundError (#3019) is a separate, unrelated failure.

msg-476560 at offset 720765 is redelivered on every restart and crashes the consumer, which is the signature of a poison message jamming a queue consumer. Its malformed nesting triggers the overflow. Skipping or quarantining the offset would also resolve it, so this is an alternative reading of the same lines.

input.recommendedAction: Roll back event-processor to the version before v4.13.7, or hotfix expandReferences to be iterative or depth-limited. Dead-letter or skip msg-476560 at events.raw offset 720765 so the consumer can resume and drain the lag. Separately, fix report-cron's missing pandas dependency in image 2026.10.2.
